title: Even-Parity Boolean Triples
statement: For each of the four elements of $\mathrm{Fin}(4)$, the corresponding Boolean triple is, in order, $(0,0,0)$, $(0,1,1)$, $(1,0,1)$, or $(1,1,0)$. These are exactly the Boolean triples with an even number of true coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: The input is an element of $\mathrm{Fin}(4)$
